study_abroad_and_senior_season.narrative: Going into senior soccer season, Owen never planned on studying abroad. Soccer had always been his primary focus, and stepping away felt risky. But during junior year, he made a last-minute decision to study in Florence, Italy with his five best friends. It was one of the hardest decisions he's made. His biggest concern was losing his starting spot, falling out of leadership consideration, or losing momentum. But Florence ended up being one of the best decisions of his life. He gained independence, perspective, and confidence. That summer, he played USL2 with Boston City FC. When he returned for senior year, he was named team captain. The team wasn't as strong, and he carried a larger responsibility. He finished with 3 goals and 3 assists (free kick vs Harvard, penalty vs Merrimack, conference goal vs Central Connecticut State). Heading into Senior Day vs LIU, they controlled their destiny in third place. They lost 1-0 and dropped to fifth, missing the tournament. Owen is most proud of the steady progression over four years and learning that growth often comes from taking risks.
